title: Baseline ACL Injury Risk Screening and Normative Data
official: Baseline ACL Injury Risk Screening and Normative Data
summary: This is a prospective, observational cohort study aimed at establishing a database of normative biomechanics for healthy athletes and surveying these athletes for 12 months following baseline testing for the occurrence of new musculoskeletal injuries, with a particular emphasis on ACL injuries.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Healthy athletes participating in formal, organized, competitive sports between the ages of 10 and 65 years old
